solarFeedInTariff.description: Retailer feed-in tariff (incl. GST, if any)

discounts.description: Receive a $25 (incl GST) one-off sign up credit on your first bill. T&Cs apply: Arcline by RACV: Terms and Conditions | Arcline by RACV

incentives.eligibility: Receive a $50 account credit if you mention an existing Arcline by RACV customer when you join. The friend also gets $50 credit. T&Cs apply - Visit Arcline by RACV Terms and Conditions page for more information: https://energy.arcline.com.au/terms/

fees.description:
Charged when a direct debit payment has dishonoured or reversed. This charge is not subject to GST.
Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at energy.arcline.com.au/fees
Charged per paper bill
May be charged when you move into a property or change retailer. Actual fee may vary.
May be charged when you move out and require a final meter read. Actual fee may vary.
May apply for over the counter payments made at an Australia Post outlet.
Cheque Dishonour fee
May be charged where you request a change, removal or installation of an electricity meter. It is to arrange metering-related goods or services for you with a meter provider or distributor.

eligibility.information: Available to Victorian residential customers with valid RACV memberships.

Additional fees may apply. For more information, please visit the retailers website at energy.arcline.com.au/fees
Charged per paper bill
May be charged when you move into a property or change retailer. Actual fee may vary.
May be charged when you move out and require a final meter read. Actual fee may vary.
May apply for over the counter payments made at an Australia Post outlet.
Cheque Dishonour fee
May be charged where you request a change, removal or installation of an electricity meter. It is to arrange metering-related goods or services for you with a meter provider or distributor.

eligibility.information: Available to Victorian residential customers with valid RACV memberships.

plans.displayName: VIC _ ENGIE EV Flex Charge Elec

solarFeedInTariff.description:
8 c/kWh for the first 8 kWh, 
1 c/kWh for every additional kWh

incentives.eligibility: Get the flexibility of charging when you're out or at home. Receive a prepaid $100 Chargefox public charging voucher for when you're out, and from 12am to 6am AEST we'll credit back 10c per kwh of energy you use at home.

fees.description: A $1.80 (inc. GST) charge will apply to paper bills sent in the post.

eligibility.information: You must have an electric vehicle (EV), either fully electric or plug-in Hybrid (PHEV) and a smart (remotely-read advanced) meter.

discounts.description: An ongoing discount of 2% to daily supply and consumption charges for customers who agree to receive invoices by email and full payment is made by the due date. The Pay on Time discount may appear as a credit on your next bill.

incentives.description: Perfect if you love free stuff
incentives.displayName: Perfect if you love free stuff
incentives.eligibility: $0.00 for the first 50kwh/day between 12pm-3pm (Local Time), excluding controlled load.
$1/Day when imports are 0.03 kWh/hour or less, between 6pm-9pm (Local Time).
10 cents/kWh applies to the first 15 kWh of exports between 6pm-9pm (Local Time) everyday, and is inclusive of any other Feed-in tariff as applicable in Energy Plan.

$1/kWh applies to any export during a Critical Peak-Export event. The timing of these events is determined at our discretion, as detailed in a notice we provide. Your premises' metering installation must support 5-minute interval data.

5 cents/kWh applies to any import during a Critical Peak-Import event. The timing of these events is determined at our discretion, as detailed in a notice we provide. Your premises' metering installation must support 5-minute interval data.
2 cents/kWh applies to exports between 4pm-11pm (Local Time) everyday.
